statistics_interpretation.uncertainty: 2000 scene-cluster bootstrap replicates, conditional on the two available training seeds; SD reported separately. Descriptive intervals, no multiple-comparison correction.
statistics_interpretation.actual_parent: Sbest - frozen Lbest: AbsRel -0.000798330, CI [-0.001664486,+0.000020977], so not established across scenes; both seeds improve numerically. RMSE and delta1 intervals also cross zero. F1 -0.023527563 and boundary-band AbsRel -0.006607946 have intervals excluding zero, both directions agree across seeds: better boundary-region depth values but worse discontinuity detection. Sfinal - Lbest gives the same directional interpretation, with AbsRel CI crossing zero, F1/band intervals excluding zero.
statistics_interpretation.best_methods: S-J best: only F1 is clearly worse by the conditional interval; other four cross zero. S-R best: AbsRel/RMSE/band better, F1 worse, delta1 inconclusive. S-B0 best: four depth/band measures better, F1 worse. These are two-seed comparisons, not the full three-seed group.
statistics_interpretation.final_methods: S-J final: AbsRel better and F1 better by the intervals, but F1 direction differs across seeds; remaining three cross zero. S-Lfinal: AbsRel/delta1/band better, F1 worse, RMSE crosses zero. S-Rfinal: AbsRel/RMSE/band better and F1 worse (F1 directions mixed), delta1 crosses zero. S-B0 final: four depth/band measures better, F1 worse with mixed seed directions. Lfinal is a separate comparison and is not the actual S starting checkpoint.
statistics_interpretation.endpoint: Across two seeds all five final-minus-best intervals cross zero. Seed 112 F1 rises 0.008221428; seed 113 falls 0.005483150. For seed 113 F1 worsens in 129/218, improves 79, ties 10; predicted edges 436840->421541 and matched GT edges 289035->283904. Zero-edge images 6->5, so not every image degrades.
statistics_interpretation.counts: Plots connect available S100 and S400 groups only; S200/S300 not yet run. Do not describe this as an adjacent planned increment or infer missing results from the connecting line.

convergence_and_cost.curve: Seed 113 begins from trained Lbest AbsRel 0.089466465; best 0.088850462 at 2100, final 0.088929763 at 3100 (+0.08925%). Training loss gradually decreases (~0.0509 to 0.04987), validation plateaus. Late indicator false and no explosive instability. Ten observed post-best validations support a near-best plateau, not continued improvement.
convergence_and_cost.stop_rule: Last significant anchor at 2100 is the raw best; ten later evaluations without a >=0.2% gain lead to the prescribed stop at 3100.
convergence_and_cost.operational_convergence: Stable step 0 means the entire S trajectory stayed within 1% of its eventual best starting from an already trained L model. Both <=0.10 and <=0.09 windows start at S0 and are confirmed at S200; this does not mean zero-cost training.
convergence_and_cost.budget: 3100 attempts/3100 successful updates, 24800 exposures, 62 effective epochs, no AMP skips/events/failures. Own stage 1318.639 s, including 795.403 s training loop, 447.677 s selection validation, 73.113 s detailed scoring; process attempt 1333.151 s. Entire parent L 953.860 s /1500 attempts; total route 2272.499 s /4600 attempts. Best including parent at 3600 attempts /1799.048 s.
convergence_and_cost.parameters: 27089 trainable F3 plus 73728 frozen LoRA parameters retained in inference (100817 adaptation parameters).
convergence_and_cost.cost_caveat: Own S peak excludes earlier L training; CUDA allocated memory is not entire-process usage. Training-loop time includes loading, not GPU compute alone. R excludes historical shared preparation.

fixed_endpoint_observations.nyuv2_0005: Best/final coarse depth almost unchanged; board depth error remains below B0 but board discontinuity is still missed. Cyan and yellow chair-edge fragments change slightly; F1 0.333->0.327 and AbsRel 0.0588->0.0593. No claim of a large visual difference.
fixed_endpoint_observations.nyuv2_0598: Best/final coarse depth nearly identical, with the right table edge largely red/missed unlike B0. Final has a few changed cyan fragments and slightly higher F1 0.407->0.413, lower AbsRel 0.0416->0.0413. Sofa and table-leg boundaries remain missed; no broad edge restoration.
fixed_endpoint_observations.nyuv2_1440: Foreground chair/table error remains stronger than B0 and increases slightly at final (AbsRel 0.1206->0.1221). Some false chair fragments shrink but the cyan vertical counter segment is lost; F1 almost unchanged 0.504->0.503. Removing predicted edges can remove both false and correct contours.
fixed_endpoint_observations.nyuv2_0226: Wall/person/sofa depth error remains substantially lower than B0 at both endpoints (AbsRel ~0.162 versus 0.584). Final slightly reduces scattered unmatched fragments; F1 0.464->0.471 while AbsRel slightly worsens. Branch false contours and furniture misses persist.
fixed_endpoint_observations.nyuv2_0246: Both endpoints underestimate much of the rear room relative to GT and have stronger errors than B0 (AbsRel ~0.170 versus 0.113). Final has slightly changed/fewer unmatched foreground-sofa fragments and F1 rises 0.476->0.486, while AbsRel worsens slightly. Ceiling false line and missed shelf/table contours persist.
fixed_endpoint_observations.nyuv2_0080: Final loses cyan matches on central/lower vertical shelf segments that were present at best. F1 0.254->0.152, predicted edge pixels 185->115, while AbsRel 0.06636->0.06647 barely changes. Raw maps are finite, positive, nonconstant, spanning about 1.25-2.09 m: this is a boundary detection loss, not a missing or constant depth output.

interpretation: Two-seed S400 shows a small numerical overall gain over the actual LoRA parent, with a consistent boundary F1 cost and better boundary-band depth error. Keep the fixed AbsRel selection rule, report final endpoints separately and finish the third seed; do not infer uniform edge improvement from stable aggregate AbsRel.
